lime.random_state: seed in every repeat; seed + 1 for lime_seed_tau

agreement.tau_strict: Kendall tau on factor-list positions (exp_025); ties by index
agreement.tau_b: scipy Kendall tau-b on |attribution|; constant vectors skipped

shap: KernelSHAP over all 126 coalitions on decision_function (log-odds)
model_threads: one thread per fit (run_local_stability._build sets n_jobs=1 on the random forest); the cohort pool is the parallelism. A threaded forest's predict_proba is not bit-reproducible and leaves 1e-16 residues where occlusion should be exactly zero.
